title: Deeper/broader Binary DXF comparator selection: LibreDWG DXB and GDAL 3.12+
mode: Primary-source comparative research and implementation-readiness update; research-only
scope: Refresh Binary DXF comparator options beyond the previously identified narrow dxfscan parser.
Separate record-codec, OGR projection, and direct binary-to-ASCII translation evidence.
Update the optional composed-checkpoint decision order without adding routine peer validation or support claims.

sources.revision: Mutable NEWS/manual/source reviewed 2026-10-19; NEWS places DXB support in the 0.14 release entry; exact run artifact remains to be pinned.
sources.observed: The 0.14 NEWS entry documents DXB input/output for dwgread, dwgwrite, and dwg2dxf, DXB output for dxfwrite, and a dedicated dxfb.test. The dxfb-check helper may compose LibreDWG with ODA File Converter, so any such result must identify the converter stage separately. LibreDWG's own DWG/DXF version and direction limits remain operation-specific.

sources.revision: Stable driver documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; binary DXF support is documented as added in GDAL 3.12.
sources.observed: The DXF driver reads Binary DXF starting in 3.12 and documents a direct binary-to-ASCII conversion path. OGR projects a selected geometry/entity subset; optional RawCodeValues covers unhandled codes, not the full original document. AC1027+ 3D extensibility exposes raw ASM data and a transform, not B-rep semantics.

Remains a narrow source-level parser lead with an Unknown fallback; this pass found no release/test evidence that makes it preferable to the more established optional comparator routes for general Binary-DXF questions.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a question-driven optional Binary-DXF comparator order: LibreDWG DXB for codec-level record questions, GDAL 3.12+ for its supported projection or direct translation boundary, and dxfscan only as a last-resort low-level source comparator. No route is a full-document or ACIS semantic oracle.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local plan crosswalk
method.limitations: The LibreDWG NEWS, manual, and helper script are mutable references; pin and verify the exact source/package at execution time. GDAL stable documentation establishes project-declared route scope, not an executed local parse. No peer artifact, Binary-DXF control, or native consumer was run.

implementationReadyChecks: Run no peer in an ordinary local implementation slice; keep local generated ASCII/Binary strict-reopen controls as the routine gate.

For an unresolved Binary-DXF record grammar/encoding question, pin a LibreDWG 0.14-series revision that contains dxfb.test and compare normalized typed fields and per-record disposition on a locally generated minimal control with a following-record sentinel.

For a supported geometry projection or direct binary-to-ASCII boundary, use only a pinned GDAL 3.12+ build; set raw-code, block inlining, encoding, geometry approximation, and 3D options explicitly as applicable.
Treat LibreDWG and GDAL output as route-specific differential evidence, not full-document preservation, DWG parity, owner-graph closure, ACIS semantics, or native acceptance.
Use dxfscan only when a named low-level question remains unanswered, and only after its source revision and buildability are pinned.
Create all controls locally from scratch in temporary storage; add no downloaded/third-party fixture, runtime dependency, routine CTest, or full-suite cadence change.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL until their existing exact external/platform or independent semantic conditions are separately satisfied.
